  .b1 { animation: juggle1 2.4s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1) infinite; }
  .b2 { animation: juggle1 2.4s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1) infinite; animation-delay: -0.8s; }

  .sun { transform-origin: 680px 90px; animation: spin 24s linear infinite; }

  @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
  @keyframes bob { from { transform: translateY(0); } to { transform: translateY(-4px); } }
  @keyframes sniff { 0%,100% { transform: rotate(0deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(2deg) translateY(1px); } }

    50%  { transform: translate(440px, 285px) rotate(25deg); opacity:1; }

- **Juggling:** 3 green bottles (with labels/corks) cycling in a parabolic juggling pattern between raised arms, with spin animation
- **Environment:** Sunny sky with smiling sun, drifting clouds, scrolling road dashes and grass, distant hills, motion lines, and ground shadow

Open the SVG in any browser to see the continuous animation.
